summary: A monophonic plucked and struck-wood synth: a noise and pulse burst excites a tuned resonator, with controls for the strike, harmonics, damping, the resonator and the envelope.
use_for: Wooden, mallet-like plucks and tuned percussion from a resonator struck by a noise or pulse burst.
quirks: Quiet at its defaults: one note A4 at velocity 100 measures about -28 LUFS (profile), so raise the master or Resonator gain.
It plays A4 at 440 Hz as written and is monophonic (the profile).
Noise to pulse and Even to odd are 255-step choices that read as percentage pairs (127 is 50 / 50); several others are value tables: time, frequency and dB at their stated ends.
Unverified: what Pulse colour's ratio and Inharmonicity's 0 to 5 mean in the signal path; the roles are guessed from names and texts.
Closed source: names come from its own texts and measurements, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-14) - monophonic, A4 at 440 Hz, -28 LUFS for one note

velocity.curve: steeper than linear (velocity squared or a dB curve)

Noise / Pulse.evidence: a choice: its texts say what it is; no role measured

Pulse Color.evidence: the start's brightness 380 Hz → 1.49 kHz (RMS frequency), the held part's 228 Hz → 448 Hz

Even / Odd.evidence: a choice: its texts say what it is; no role measured

Brightness.evidence: the start's brightness 152 Hz → 2.3 kHz (RMS frequency), the held part's 186 Hz → 305 Hz

parameters.name: Noise / Pulse
parameters.how: Mixes the noise and pulse excitation that strikes the resonator, from all noise at 0 through an even mix at 127 (the default) to all pulse at 254.
parameters.sound: More noise is a breathy, hissy strike; more pulse is a clicky, pitched one.

parameters.name: Noise Time
parameters.how: Sets the length of the noise burst, from 1 ms through about 4.5 ms at the default to 10 s (a table).
parameters.sound: A short burst is a sharp tick; a long one is a sustained scrape that keeps feeding the resonator.

parameters.name: Pulse Color
parameters.how: Sets the colour of the pulse excitation as a ratio, about 2 at 0 up to 20 at 254 (about 4 at the default).
parameters.sound: It moves the pulse from a duller to a brighter click; the exact meaning of the number was not measured.

parameters.name: Even / Odd
parameters.how: Mixes even and odd harmonics, all even at 0, equal at 127 (the default), all odd at 254.
parameters.sound: Even harmonics sound fuller and rounder; odd ones hollow and woody, like a clarinet.

parameters.name: Inharmonicity
parameters.description: Stretches the partials away from exact multiples of the pitch, from 0 (none, the default) up to 5 at 254.
parameters.how: Stretches the partials away from exact multiples of the pitch, from 0 (none, the default) up to 5 at 254.
parameters.sound: Small amounts add a bell- or wood-block-like colour; larger ones turn the pitch clangorous.

parameters.name: Damping
parameters.how: Sets the frequency above which the ringing is damped, from 250 Hz at 0 through about 5.9 kHz at the default to 22 kHz at 254.
parameters.sound: A lower value mutes the highs quickly for a dull, dead wood; a higher one lets them ring.

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.how: Sets the brightness of the strike, from 100 Hz at 0 through about 1 kHz at the default to 10 kHz at 254.
parameters.sound: A higher value is a brighter attack; a lower one a soft, muffled mallet.

parameters.name: Resonator F
parameters.how: Sets the centre frequency of the resonator, from 20 Hz at 0 through about 620 Hz at the default to 20 kHz at 254.
parameters.sound: It tunes the body that colours the note: low is a boomy box, high a thin tick.

parameters.name: Resonator Q
parameters.how: Sets the resonator's Q, from 0.0625 at 0 through about 1 at the default to 16 at 254.
parameters.sound: A higher Q rings and whistles at the resonator frequency; a low one is broad and gentle.

parameters.name: Resonator G
parameters.how: Sets the resonator's gain, from -40 dB at 0 through about 0 dB at the default to +40 dB at 254.
parameters.sound: More gain makes the body louder against the dry strike; at the top it can overload the output.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.how: Sets how long the sound takes to fade after the strike, from 1 ms at 0 through about 2.5 s at the default to 10 s at 254.
parameters.sound: A short decay is a muted block; a long one is a ringing bar or string.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.how: Sets how long the sound takes to die after the note ends, from 1 ms at 0 through about 87 ms at the default (80) to 2.5 s at 254.
parameters.sound: A short release stops the note abruptly; a long one lets it tail away.
